info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Administration Collections API
info.description: The Collateral Administration Collections API provides access to detailed information about specific collections within the banking system. By utilizing a unique collection ID, users can retrieve comprehensive data regarding collateral and associated financial assets. This API is primarily used by financial institutions and administrators to monitor, manage, and analyze collateralized collections. Typical consumers include risk managers, compliance officers, and operational teams responsible for collateral management and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information on a specific collateral collection identified by RES-100045. It is designed to help users access relevant data efficiently and support decision-making processes related to collateral management.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving detailed information about the collection identified by RES-100045. This request expects a JSON payload formatted according to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the response contains the requested data.

GetCollateralAdministrationCollectionRes.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the collateral administration collections. It contains a simple string value.

GetCollateralAdministrationCollectionRes.title: Collateral Collection Response

assetType.description: Type of asset associated with the collateral.

marketValue.description: Current market value of the collateral.

valuationDate.description: Date when the asset was last valued.

securedExposureId.description: Identifier of the secured exposure related to the collateral.

haircutPercent.description: Percentage haircut applied to the market value.

lienStatus.description: Status of the lien on the collateral.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the collateral record was last updated.

GetCollateralAdministrationCollectionRes.description: Response schema representing the details of a collateral collection.
